# Welvia
Welvia makes business information and request workflows easier for people and compatible agents to use.

- [Homepage](https://welvia.natemitchcook.com/): Services and approach.
- [Action contract](https://welvia.natemitchcook.com/openapi.json): Business facts, questions, onboarding and request receipts.

Business pages use /?business=<business_id> and load their content from the backend. Private pages and requests require a business-specific invitation. The invitation must not be shared with unrelated agents or businesses. Published service rules govern requests; staff confirms availability, pricing and acceptance. A saved receipt is not an accepted order. Owner answers require review before changing approved facts. Never invent policies or ordering-provider capabilities.
